definitions.metric_aggregation: Precision/recall/F1 are query macro means; TP/FP/FN are pooled product occurrences
definitions.oracle_product_filtering: When full union covers truth but no whole-path subset union is exact, product-level oracle pruning would be necessary
definitions.oracle_subset_union: Any of 15 nonempty whole-path subsets unioned; chosen using labels only for diagnostic ceiling
definitions.presence_masks: Four characters in rank1,rank2,rank3,rank4 order; 0000 means absent everywhere
definitions.union: Union of all four eligible SAME-processed candidate sets; no truth repair

limitations: No trained model, graph relations, checkpoint reads, or protected test records used
Repeated seed-query observations are not independent new test cases
Exact subset choices and best F1 use labels; they are not proposed runtime selectors
Union metrics are not quality of the deployed set selector
scope: Frozen validation only; unions and subset choices are analysis-only
